## Adapter text (quoted — source of truth)

> Copy the reviewed packages/dex-agent-plugin folder to ~/.codex/plugins/dex. Add or update ~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json so Dex is listed with source.path ./.codex/plugins/dex — that path is relative to the marketplace root (the home folder for a personal list), not the .agents/plugins folder.
